model-and-cache: stores that share an embedding model share one embedding cache.

Two stores use the same model and add the same file. The cache holds one embedding per distinct
text, not one per store, so it has two entries (the file's two chunks) after both adds. kb model
cache shows and clears it, and kb model list shows the real models, never the test-only fake:*.

  $ kb init --model fake:8
  created location $WORK/proj/.kb
  created store "default" in $WORK/proj (model fake:8)

  $ kb init --name second --model fake:8
  created store "second" in $WORK/proj (model fake:8)

  $ kb add $WORK/notes/tmux.md
  added data/tmux.md (2 chunks)

  $ kb --store second add $WORK/notes/tmux.md
  added data-second/tmux.md (2 chunks)

  $ kb model cache
  ~ embedding cache \$WORK/home/Library/Caches/kb/embed-cache\.sqlite: 2 entries, \d+ bytes
  fake:8                                      8 dims  2 entries

  $ kb model cache --clear
  cleared the embedding cache $WORK/home/Library/Caches/kb/embed-cache.sqlite

  $ kb model cache
  ~ embedding cache \$WORK/home/Library/Caches/kb/embed-cache\.sqlite: 0 entries, \d+ bytes

  $ write data-second/tmux.md @tmux-v2

  $ kb --store second reindex --all
  reindexed data-second/tmux.md (2 chunks, 1 embedded)
  entries: 1 scanned, 1 reindexed, 0 skipped; chunks: 2; embed calls: 1

  $ kb model cache
  ~ embedding cache \$WORK/home/Library/Caches/kb/embed-cache\.sqlite: 1 entries, \d+ bytes
  fake:8                                      8 dims  1 entries

  $ kb model list
  BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5                     768 dims  not downloaded
  BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5                    384 dims  not downloaded (default)
  nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5            768 dims  not downloaded
  sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2    384 dims  not downloaded

The model path of a test-only model is an error: only real models have a directory.

  $ kb model path
  [stderr] kb model path: unknown embedding model "fake:8" (supported: BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5, BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5, nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5, sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2)
  [exit 1]

# Tmux survives logout

Start tmux on the remote host and detach.
-- @tmux-v2 --

# Tmux survives logout

Start tmux on the remote host and detach. Reattach with tmux attach.
